1Signing in — two doors, one dashboard

Open your dashboard URL and press Sign in. There are two doors:

1Staff: type the username + password your Owner gave you (e.g. counselor). You land directly on YOUR work screen.
2Owner (Admin Key): leave the username EMPTY and type your Admin Key as the password. You see everything, including Staff & Roles.
3First login? Change your password immediately: ❓ Help → Change my password. Forgot it? Only the Owner can reset it (Staff & Roles → 🔑 Reset password).
The login page explains both doors in plain English + Telugu.
✅ You only see what you were allocated. A counselor sees their To-Do and leads; a Director sees numbers; nobody sees what the Owner did not give them.

2Overview — your command center (2 minutes a day)

1🎯 What to do today: the panel at the top IS your morning. URGENT = parents going cold. Press Go → to jump to that screen.
2KPI row: total leads, joined (🎓), visits booked, follow-ups due, open tasks.
3₹ cards: enter ad spend in Settings first — then read Cost per Lead and Cost per JOINED student vs ₹3.4L seat value. This is your money truth.
4Funnel & Source cards: find the cheapest source that produces JOINED students — move your ad budget there.
5🔔 Bell (top-right): red badge = number of urgent items. Click it to jump to the action list.

3Leads — every enquiry, scored and source-tagged

Every parent enquiry arrives here automatically — website chat, Meta ad, QR hoarding, missed call, referral or walk-in. Each lead has a score (hot leads float up), a source tag (which ad rupee produced it) and a stage.

1Click the stage dropdown and advance as you work: new → ai_engaged → contacted → interested → visit_booked → visited → applied → seat_booked → joined.
2Tick consent before sending any WhatsApp (the law requires it).
3Lost a lead? Mark it lost — the funnel keeps the learning.
4Use the source dropdown when entering walk-ins so ROI stays honest.
💡 The score (0–100) sorts your day: 60+ = call today, 30–59 = this week, below = nurture sequence.

4Lead-360° drawer — a parent's full story

Click any lead row. A drawer slides in with the complete history: every chat message (parent in teal, AI in white), every follow-up sent, every task — in one timeline, newest last. Above it: score chips, stage, branch/rank.

1Assign: pick a counselor in the dropdown → Assign. They now own the follow-up (visible in their To-Do).
2Read the full story BEFORE calling — the parent never has to repeat themselves.
3Close with the ✕ when done.

5Chats (AI) — what parents asked, how the AI answered

Every AI conversation, with citations (📚 = which approved fact was used) and flags:

What you seeWhat it meansWhat to do
📚 citation lineAnswer came from YOUR approved Knowledge PackNothing — that's the system working
⚠️ trap-question handled honestlyParent asked "100% guarantee unda?" — AI refused honestlyThe task list already has a call task — a human should follow up

The honest refusal, from the parent's side — trap questions protect your college's name.

6Counselor To-Do — the daily call list

This is a counselor's whole world. Every urgent thing becomes a task: hot leads idle 48h, complaint handoffs, parent asked for a human, trap-question follow-ups, visit reminders.

1Work top to bottom — hottest first.
2After each call: press ✓ Done and advance the lead's stage in Leads.
3Inbox zero by evening = a good day. New tasks appear automatically every morning.

7Follow-ups — automatic day-2/7/12 nudges

No lead goes cold: SeatSetu schedules polite bilingual nudges on day 2, 7 and 12 after every enquiry.

1Press Run scheduler once a day (morning). It creates/queues the due nudges.
2Consent-gated: only parents who agreed to be contacted are messaged — the rest wait for a phone call.
3See everything DUE in one glance; overdue rows turn red.
💡 WhatsApp sending is mock (log) until the Owner turns on the WhatsApp Cloud API keys in Vercel — Pooja Soft Solutions switches it on for you.

8Reports — the printable one-pager & exports

1Management One-Pager: funnel + source ROI + AQAR status + placement readiness on ONE printable page — for board meetings.
2CSV exports: leads, follow-ups, conversations — for Excel people.
3Print: the page is print-styled; press Ctrl+P for a clean PDF.

9Knowledge Pack + Comparison Pack — the AI's only truth

The AI is allowed to say ONLY what is in this pack. That is why it never invents fees or promises jobs.

1About / Location / Admission process: short prose in both languages is best.
2Courses & fees table: convener ₹, management ₹, intake, cutoff note. This feeds fee answers, the brochure PDF and rank maths.
3Hostels, bus routes, placements, key dates: keep them current — the widget quotes them verbatim.
4Press Save & re-index Knowledge Pack after edits — the AI picks it up instantly.

🏫 Comparison Pack (bottom of this page)

The parent's view: asking "RIT vs Sri Vision?" gets the sourced comparison + a visit offer.

Add the 2–3 nearby colleges parents always ask about — public numbers only (their fee, placements %, closing ranks) plus a source note, their strength and your edge. When a parent asks "RIT vs Sri Vision?" the AI compares honestly from exactly these numbers — credits their strength, states your edge — and offers a campus visit. For unlisted colleges it politely refuses to guess. That honesty wins parents.

10Settings — ad spend, Monday digest, backup

1💰 Ad spend: enter what you spent per source (Meta, hoarding QR, newspaper…). The ₹ ROI cards on Overview come alive from this.
2📮 Monday digest: every Monday 9am — press Copy WhatsApp digest and paste it to the principal's WhatsApp. Plain words: leads, visits, joins, what to do this week.
3📦 Backup: one click downloads everything (leads, careers, conversations, Knowledge Pack) as a ZIP. Your data, yours.
4System status: shows which powers are live (WhatsApp sending, AI brain, Meta signature). Ask Pooja Soft Solutions to switch on what you need.
✅ Settings opens for Owner / Principal / Director / Management — never for counselors. Staff accounts are Owner-only (next section).

11Staff & Roles — one login per person (Owner only)

Eight ready roles — Owner, Principal, Director, Management, Admin Office, Counselor, Placement, IQAC — each with a sensible default screen set. Seven preset logins exist from day one (principal123, counselor123, …) — change them in week 1.

Create a login

1➕ Add a staff member: name, mobile, role, college → Create login.
2A temp password is generated and shown once — press 💬 Send on WhatsApp to hand it over.
3The person appears in the team table with last login tracking — 'never logged in' means: call and help them.

🎚️ Allocate — decide exactly what each person sees

1Press Allocate on any person → tick their screens → Save access. Applies on their very next click.
2Use role default restores the preset. 🔑 Reset password issues a new one-time password.
3🚫 Deactivate locks out staff who left — instantly, without deleting their history.

12Website Widget — put the AI on your website

1Copy the one-line embed script and give it to your webmaster — they paste it before </body>. The AI counselor bubble appears on every page of your site.
2Test the chips: fee, hostel, placements, transport — answers come from YOUR Knowledge Pack.
3Parents can 🎤 speak (Telugu), 👍 rate answers, and 📲 install your college as an app (PWA).

13Operations Playbook — the recipe book

Ten steps from onboarding to AQAR season — written for busy people. New staff member? Point them here (their Help tab covers their own role). This is also the demo script card on Overview — the 3-minute version to show any visitor.

14SeatSetu Accred — AQAR before Dec 31

1Create course registrations for each programme (one time).
2Upload semester marks Excel/CSV per course (sample CSV provided) → run attainment → CO/PO reports + gap analysis appear.
3Exit survey: add pass percentage from survey data.
4Evidence vault: collect items all year, mark done, attach notes. The readiness % climbs toward the Dec 31 AQAR deadline — the countdown is on your Overview every day.
5Export evidence CSVs when writing the AQAR — everything dated, everything filed.

15SeatSetu Careers — voice mock interviews

A realistic interview room: the interviewer speaks questions aloud (🔊 en-IN), the student answers by 🎙️ voice or typing in Telugu-English, and weak answers get panel follow-up probes ("walk me through it step by step"). Turn on Strict panel for tougher scoring.

1Enter name / roll / branch / role → Begin interview. 5 questions: HR → technical → scenario.
2Student answers (voice or typing) → Score answer → instant score + STAR tip. Answer the amber panel follow-up when it appears.
3✅ Finish & save report → readiness /5. Every report is a dated NAAC 5.1.2 training record.
4Export NAAC evidence CSV at season end and drop it into the Accred vault.
5Coach everyone listed below 2.5 → re-test. Readiness climbs — that's the story the T&P officer tells.

16Compliance & Log — consent, STOP, kill switch

1DPDP consent ledger: who said yes, when, on which channel — WhatsApp nudges fire only for consented parents.
2STOP: any lead can be marked stop — every channel goes silent for them.
3Kill switch: one button pauses ALL AI replies instantly (maintenance or a sensitive day).
4Audit log: every AI answer, guardrail hit and staff action — immutable, timestamped. Show it to any committee.

17The parent's side — widget & visit booking

Parents type or speak in Telugu, get honest cited answers in seconds, then — the part that fills seats — press Book campus visit: name, phone, date, branch. A lead is created, a visit task lands in your To-Do, and the parent gets a document checklist (EAPCET hall ticket, memos, Aadhaar…). They can also request the brochure PDF.

19First-week checklist + troubleshooting

1Day 1: Owner changes preset passwords (7 logins) · creates real staff logins · allocates screens · sends on WhatsApp.
2Day 2: fill the Knowledge Pack (courses, fees, hostels, buses, placements, dates) · add 2–3 Comparison Pack colleges.
3Day 3: ad spend entered · widget embedded on the website · test chats (fees, hostel, 'guarantee unda?').
4Day 4: counselor dry-run: chat → lead → call → visit booked. Follow-up scheduler ON.
5Day 5: Monday digest tested to the principal's WhatsApp · backup downloaded · audit log reviewed.
